Reference / strings/format

strings/format#

Exact, typed interpolation: only {} denotes a slot; other braces are literal.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Formatted("{} version {}", id, id.version()).string();
out.writeln(Formatted("{} of {} done", done, total));

Description#

Exact, typed interpolation: only {} denotes a slot; other braces are literal.

Each value after the pattern is turned into text by its own string(), as any ...string tail does: numbers, bool, char, and objects that answer string(). Formatted(pattern:, values:) takes texts already made.

Public API#

object Formatted#

object Formatted

A pattern with {} slots filled in order: Formatted("{} of {}", done, total).string().

Formatted.Formatted#

Formatted(:pattern, :values)

Fills the slots of pattern with values already made into text.

Formatted.Formatted#

Formatted(pattern is string, values is ...string)

Fills the slots of pattern with each value's string().

Formatted.string#

string() is string

The filled text; InvalidFormat when slots and values do not match.
